items.q: What does Ochaworth Leadership and Community Development Initiative do?
items.a:
Ochaworth Leadership and Community Development Initiative (OLCDI) is a CAC-registered, youth-led nonprofit organization (CAC/RN/7290687) committed to promoting women’s rights, gender equality, social justice, leadership, and inclusive community development.

Our work focuses on empowering women and girls to birth the more in them, know their worth, and live their worth. We support communities through initiatives such as:

•⁠  ⁠Women and girls’ empowerment and leadership development
•⁠  ⁠Mentorship and capacity-building programs
•⁠  ⁠Gender equality and women’s rights advocacy
•⁠  ⁠Comprehensive Psychosocial Support Services including shelter referral, Legal Aid Services, Trauma Healing, Educational support, psychotherapy, life skills and skills acquisition programs etc
•⁠  ⁠Community awareness and social justice campaigns
•⁠  ⁠Sexual and Gender Based Violence Prevention and Response 
•⁠  ⁠Breast Cancer Awareness 
•⁠  ⁠⁠menstrual Health Education and pads distribution to girls.

We primarily support women, girls, young people, and underserved or vulnerable members of communities, particularly those who face barriers to opportunity, participation, and personal or economic development.

items.q: How can i donate or support Ochaworth?
items.a:
You can support Ochaworth’s work by making a financial donation, sponsoring a program, providing resources, partnering with us, or contributing your professional skills and expertise.

Financial donations:
Donations can be made through our designated organizational bank account.

Other ways to support us include:

•⁠  ⁠Sponsoring a woman or girl to participate in a training program
•⁠  ⁠Supporting a community empowerment project
•⁠  ⁠Donating educational or program materials
•⁠  ⁠Providing professional or technical expertise
•⁠  ⁠Partnering with us on projects and advocacy initiatives
•⁠  ⁠Becoming a volunteer
•⁠  ⁠Connecting us with potential donors, foundations, institutions, or corporate partners
•⁠  ⁠Sharing our work and campaigns with your network

For donation details, please contact our team through our official contact channels.

items.q: How can i become a volunteer ?
items.a:
We welcome individuals who are passionate about women’s rights, gender equality, youth development, social justice, community development, leadership, and service.

Volunteers may contribute through areas such as:

•⁠  ⁠Community outreach
•⁠  ⁠Mentorship
•⁠  ⁠Training and facilitation
•⁠  ⁠Research and advocacy
•⁠  ⁠Communications and social media
•⁠  ⁠Event support
•⁠  ⁠Fundraising and resource mobilization
•⁠  ⁠Administration and program support

Basic requirements:

•⁠  ⁠Commitment to Ochaworth’s mission and values
•⁠  ⁠Willingness to serve and work respectfully with diverse communities
•⁠  ⁠Good communication and teamwork skills
•⁠  ⁠Reliability and willingness to learn
•⁠  ⁠Relevant professional or technical skills are an added advantage

Every contribution helps us create opportunities and deliver programs that directly benefit women, girls, young people, and communities.

Donations may support:

•⁠  ⁠Training, workshops, mentorship, and leadership programs
•⁠  ⁠Advocacy and awareness campaigns
•⁠  ⁠Skills development and livelihood initiatives
•⁠  ⁠Educational materials and other resources for beneficiaries
•⁠  ⁠Community outreach and engagement
•⁠  ⁠Program monitoring, evaluation, and follow-up
•⁠  ⁠Transportation and logistics required to deliver activities
•⁠  ⁠Essential administrative and operational costs that enable our programs to run effectively

We are committed to using donated resources responsibly, transparently, and efficiently, with priority given to activities that advance our mission and create meaningful impact for the communities we serve.

items.q: How can someone apply for or receive your support?
items.a:
Ochaworth provides support through specific programs and initiatives designed around the needs of the communities we serve. Eligibility may therefore vary depending on the particular program.

Generally, individuals who may benefit from our programs include women, girls, young people, and underserved or vulnerable community members who meet the criteria established for a particular intervention.

Depending on the program, applicants may be asked to:

1.⁠ ⁠Complete an application or registration form.
2.⁠ ⁠Provide basic information about themselves and their needs.
3.⁠ ⁠Participate in an assessment or selection process where applicable.
4.⁠ ⁠Meet the eligibility requirements for the specific program.
5.⁠ ⁠Participate in the relevant training, mentorship, empowerment, or support activity.

To apply for support:
Please contact Ochaworth through our official communication channels.

Our team will provide guidance on available programs, eligibility requirements, and the appropriate application process.



Our Commitment

At Ochaworth Leadership and Community Development Initiative, we believe that every woman and girl deserves the opportunity to know her worth, live her worth, and birth the more in her.

Through collective action, partnership, advocacy, and community-driven solutions, we are working toward communities where women and girls can thrive, lead, participate, and create lasting change.
